question: The Reserve Bank had first introduced the Banking Ombudsman Scheme in ______ to provide expeditious and inexpensive forum to bank customers for resolution of their complaints relating to deficiency in banking services.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1995**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Banking Ombudsman Scheme** was first introduced by the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** in the year **1995**.
 
• This scheme was launched to provide an **expeditious** and **inexpensive forum** for addressing complaints by bank customers relating to deficiencies in **banking services**.
 
• The scheme aimed to enhance **customer protection** by resolving disputes between customers and banks in a structured manner.
 
• The **Banking Ombudsman** acts as an independent adjudicator to handle complaints regarding services provided by banks, such as delays, non-disbursement of loans, non-payment or delay in collection of cheques, and others.
 
• The scheme has undergone multiple revisions over the years to expand its coverage and include more services, the latest being the **Integrated Ombudsman Scheme** of **2021**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Banking Ombudsman Scheme Evolution:**

 
 
• The scheme was revised in **2002** to incorporate additional banking services and streamline the complaint redressal process.
 
• In **2006**, the scheme was further simplified to make it more accessible to customers, including the introduction of an electronic complaint filing system.
 
• The **Integrated Ombudsman Scheme** launched in **2021** merged the Banking Ombudsman Scheme with other ombudsman schemes to create a unified structure for grievance redressal across financial institutions.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of the Banking Ombudsman Scheme:**
 
 
• The ombudsman handles complaints related to **deficiency in banking services**, such as non-payment or delay in issuing drafts, wrong debits, and misrepresentation of terms.
 
• The scheme covers both **scheduled commercial banks** and **regional rural banks (RRBs)**.
 
• Complaints can be filed **free of cost**, and customers are not required to hire a lawyer or financial expert to represent them.
 
 
 
• **Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2021:**
 
 
• This scheme integrates the **Banking Ombudsman Scheme**, **NBFC Ombudsman Scheme**, and **Digital Transactions Ombudsman Scheme** into a single framework.
 
• The motto of this scheme is "**One Nation, One Ombudsman**", enabling customers to lodge complaints through a single portal regardless of the type of financial institution.
 
• It simplifies the grievance redressal process and ensures a more **uniform and transparent mechanism**.
 
 
 
• **Important Points:**
 
 
• The **Banking Ombudsman** is appointed by the **Reserve Bank of India** under Section 35A of the **Banking Regulation Act, 1949**.
 
• Customers can approach the ombudsman if their complaints are not resolved by the bank within **30 days** of filing.
 
• The scheme ensures that disputes are resolved in a **time-bound manner**, typically within **30 days to 60 days**.
